claim.purpose: Complete the unfinished #5409 production supervision, observed readiness, assembled soak, and credential-overlap acceptance boundary

initial.title: [v0.91.7][review-fix][WP-07A] Complete the unfinished #5409 runtime acceptance boundary
initial.goal: Make the Runtime v2 production topology, readiness, soak, and credential renewal satisfy #5409 truthfully.
initial.required_outcome: Production uses supervised tasks, readiness consumes observed health, the soak exercises running assembly behavior, and credential rotation has bounded overlap.
authority_boundary: GitHub #5409 remains the product acceptance issue
Retained #5409 terminal evidence is immutable premature-closeout history
Issue #5494 is the corrective execution authority
initial.task_boundary: Complete only the four remaining WP-07A findings and reconcile their proof truth.
deliverables: Updated WP-07A proof and register disposition
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Production executes declared required components through the supervisor
AC2: Readiness consumes observed health for every required component and typed channel
AC3: The deterministic soak runs supervised tasks and channels and proves failure and recovery readiness transitions
AC4: Credential renewal accepts old and new generations only during bounded overlap and revocation rejects both
AC5: #5409 and the canonical register close only after exact-revision review and proving validation
dependencies: Existing Runtime v2 supervision and typed-channel primitives
initial.plan_summary: Wire observed supervised assembly into production readiness, add a behavioral soak, implement bounded credential overlap, and retain exact proof.

steps.action: Implement observed supervised production assembly and readiness
Implement behavioral assembled-runtime soak with failure and recovery
Implement bounded credential overlap and revocation tests
Validate, review, publish, and reconcile #5409/register truth

risks: Supervision integration could duplicate existing long-lived task ownership
Readiness could over-constrain optional degraded components
Credential overlap could accidentally weaken explicit revocation
invariants: Revocation is terminal for all credential generations
No secrets enter logs or retained proof
No Runtime v3 or AWS changes
stop_conditions: A required runtime component has no observable health source
Production integration requires changes outside the protected Runtime v2 paths
review_prompts: Does production execute rather than merely describe the assembly?
Can any required missing or unhealthy observation leave readiness green?
Does the soak drive real tasks, channels, failure, and recovery?
Is credential overlap bounded without weakening revocation?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove supervision, topology, soak, and authentication behavior
Prove the integrated Runtime v2 readiness consumer
Prove the retained #5409 repair packet and canonical register disposition match reviewed implementation truth

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on static-only topology, missing observed health, non-behavioral soak proof, unbounded overlap, weakened revocation, or scope expansion.
